Asks clarifying questions from the list/empty-state categories in product-questions.md. Produces tech translation with codebase exploration. Skips split (estimated <500L, frontend-only). Runs implementation loop with jest + storybook test strategy. Applies Gate Rule at every transition.
expectations: Calls Linear MCP get_issue to fetch EP-1234 ticket details
Identifies feature type as list/empty-state and asks questions from those categories in references/product-questions.md
Questions are multiple-choice (not open-ended), max 3 per batch
Produces a synthesis summary with edge cases and acceptance criteria before proceeding to Part 2
Explores codebase for existing list/empty-state components and patterns
Proposes reusable components vs. new ones to build
Part 3 (Tracking) is offered since this is user-facing
Part 4 estimates <500L and frontend-only, so no split is needed — jumps to Part 6

expectations: Calls Linear MCP get_issue to fetch EP-5678
Part 1 asks clarifying questions about the badge display, eligibility states, permissions
Part 2 identifies both frontend (new EligibilityBadge component) and backend (API endpoint or extension) work

Part 5 proposes breakdown: Migration ticket (if DB change), Backend ticket, Frontend ticket
Part 5 creates sub-tickets via Linear MCP save_issue with parent link to EP-5678
Part 5 displays created ticket URLs
Implementation order is Migration (if any) → Backend → Frontend
Part 6 loops: runs 6a-6e for each sub-ticket before moving to next
Backend sub-ticket uses pytest test strategy from references/testing-strategy.md
Frontend sub-ticket uses jest + storybook test strategy
Gate Rule applied at every Part transition and every 6a→6b→6c→6d→6e sub-step

evals.name: gate-rule-skip-and-stop
evals.prompt: /guided-feature-development https://linear.app/alan-eu/issue/EP-7890/add-notification-preferences — user says 'skip' to tracking, 'stop' after technical plan
evals.expected_output: Skill respects Gate Rule at every transition. When user says 'skip' for Part 3 (tracking), it skips and asks about Part 4. When user says 'stop' after Part 2, it pauses without auto-proceeding. Never takes initiative to skip or reorder steps.
expectations: After Part 1 completion, asks: '[Part 1] done. Proceed to Technical Plan (Part 2)?'
Waits for explicit user confirmation before starting Part 2
After Part 2 completion, asks: '[Part 2] done. Proceed to Tracking (Part 3)?'
When user says 'skip', skill skips Part 3 and asks about Part 4 instead
Does NOT auto-proceed to Part 4 without asking after skip
When user says 'stop', skill pauses completely — does NOT continue to next Part
Never auto-proceeds between any Parts without explicit user confirmation
Never takes initiative to skip or reorder steps on its own
Gate Rule question format matches: '[Step/Part X] done. Proceed to [next step name]?'
Offers 'yes', 'skip', and 'stop' as options at each gate

evals.name: session2-no-re-exploration
evals.expected_output: Skill reads the plan file and starts Part 6 directly. Does NOT spawn Explore agents or re-fetch Linear/Figma. Uses plan's Key Files and Grep Search Queries for codebase lookups. If plan is ambiguous, asks user instead of re-exploring.
expectations: Reads the plan file at the provided path
Jumps directly to Part 6 without running Parts 1-5
Does NOT call Linear MCP get_issue — ticket context is already in the plan
Does NOT invoke /figma-to-murray-code or Figma MCP — specs are already in the plan
Does NOT spawn an Explore subagent — uses Grep directly with plan's pre-built queries
Uses Read tool to understand file structure, not Explore
If a concept is not covered in the plan's Key Files, asks the user instead of re-exploring
Uses Figma specs from the plan's 'Figma Specs' section as-is for Part 6b implementation
Gate Rule applied at every 6a→6b→6c→6d→6e sub-step

Each question has concrete options (2-4 per question), not open-ended text
Gate Rule transitions use AskUserQuestion with 'Yes, proceed' / 'Skip' / 'Stop here' options
No questions appear as plain text with bullet-point choices that require typing
Part 2 config/catalog audit question uses AskUserQuestion
Part 3 tracking confirmation uses AskUserQuestion
Part 6c review findings question uses AskUserQuestion
Checkpoint is written immediately after each Part confirmation, not deferred

evals.name: architecture-alternatives-review
evals.prompt: /guided-feature-development https://linear.app/alan-eu/issue/EP-2222/add-prescription-renewal-flow — user confirms Part 2 architecture, then accepts alternatives review. The proposed architecture is: new PrescriptionRenewalWizard component + new /api/prescriptions/renew endpoint + new DB column renewal_status on prescriptions table.
evals.expected_output: After Part 2 Step 3 architecture confirmation, skill asks if user wants to explore alternatives. On 'yes', spawns a single subagent that returns 3 alternatives (Cleaner, Faster, Bolder) as structured JSON. Presents them via AskUserQuestion. If user picks one, reworks architecture accordingly.
expectations: After Part 2 Step 3 confirmation, uses AskUserQuestion to ask 'Want to explore alternative approaches before committing?' with options 'Yes, review alternatives' and 'Skip, I'm happy with this approach'
Spawns exactly 1 subagent (not 3) for the alternatives review
Subagent receives the confirmed architecture, product requirements from Part 1, and codebase exploration results from Part 2 Step 2
Subagent returns structured JSON with 3 alternatives: Cleaner, Faster, Bolder
Each alternative includes: summary, approach diff vs original, tradeoffs, estimated LOC delta
Alternatives are genuinely different from each other — not 3 variations of the same idea
Presents alternatives via AskUserQuestion with options: 'Stick with original', 'Dig into Cleaner', 'Dig into Faster', 'Dig into Bolder'
If user picks an alternative, reworks the architecture proposal and re-confirms before proceeding
Checkpoint Part 2 section includes which alternatives were considered and rationale for final choice
Does NOT spawn Explore agents during the alternatives review — reuses existing codebase data

evals.name: architecture-alternatives-skip
evals.prompt: /guided-feature-development https://linear.app/alan-eu/issue/EP-3333/add-member-search-filters — user confirms Part 2 architecture, then skips alternatives review
evals.expected_output: After Part 2 Step 3 confirmation, skill asks if user wants to explore alternatives. User says 'Skip'. Skill proceeds directly to checkpoint write and Part 3 without spawning any alternatives subagent.
expectations: After Part 2 Step 3 confirmation, uses AskUserQuestion to offer alternatives review
When user selects 'Skip, I'm happy with this approach', does NOT spawn any subagent
Proceeds directly to writing the Part 2 checkpoint
Moves to Part 3 gate without delay
No wasted tokens on alternatives exploration when user doesn't want it
